name: Blender 3D
about: Uses the Blender installed on this PC (background, factory settings, no add-ons, no auto-run scripts). The AI only writes a recipe (data) — a fixed script builds it: rounded edges, smooth shapes, colours, a rendered picture, STL per part + GLB. Best for furniture, cases, stands, decorative and smooth objects.
description: Makes 3D models in BLENDER from a recipe: furniture (a ready-made parametric cabinet with drawers and doors), cases, stands, holders, smooth or rounded objects, text, coloured models; exports STL per part and GLB, and renders a picture. Use it when the user says Blender, or for furniture / cabinets / shelves, or when they want a rendered, coloured model.
instructions:
Turn the request into a Blender recipe (JSON). Millimetres, Z is up, the FRONT faces -Y (the viewer looks from the front).
1) Furniture with drawers / doors / shelves (cabinet, dresser, nightstand, sideboard, dulap, comoda): answer ONLY {"name": "...", "template": "cabinet", "options": {"width": 500, "height": 500, "depth": 300, "drawers": 2, "doors": 2, "board": 18, "color": "#c8a27a", "handle_color": "#333333"}} — drawers go on top, doors underneath; 0 is allowed. Put in options only what the user said (a size like 500 x 500 x 300 = width x height x depth).
2) Anything else: {"name", "template": "none", "parts": [...]}. Each part: name, shape and location = the CENTRE of the shape [x, y, z]. Shapes: box (size [x,y,z]), cylinder (radius, depth = its height along Z), cone (radius = bottom, radius2 = top, depth), sphere (radius), torus (major = ring radius, minor = tube radius), text (text, font_size, depth). rotation [x,y,z] in degrees (a cylinder lying along X: [0,90,0]).
Options per part: bevel (rounded edges in mm, 1-5 looks good), smooth true (smooth shading), subdivide 1-2 (rounder), cut [shapes to subtract, same fields] for holes and pockets, array {count, offset [dx,dy,dz]} for copies in a row, mirror "x" (a copy mirrored across the centre line), color "#rrggbb", metal 0-1, group (parts with the same group become ONE printed piece), reference true for bought things (screws, hinges).
Separate printed pieces touching each other need a 0.3-0.5 mm gap (they are checked for collisions). Walls >= 1.6 mm for printing.
Example - a phone stand: {"name": "phone stand", "template": "none", "parts": [{"name": "base", "shape": "box", "size": [80, 70, 6], "location": [0, 0, 3], "bevel": 2, "group": "stand"}, {"name": "back", "shape": "box", "size": [80, 6, 90], "location": [0, 18, 45], "rotation": [-15, 0, 0], "bevel": 2, "group": "stand"}, {"name": "lip", "shape": "box", "size": [80, 8, 12], "location": [0, -28, 12], "bevel": 2, "group": "stand", "cut": [{"shape": "cylinder", "radius": 6, "depth": 20, "location": [0, -28, 12], "rotation": [90, 0, 0]}]}]} Example - a mug (hollow = a cut, a handle = half a torus: the cut box removes the half inside): {"name": "mug", "template": "none", "parts": [{"name": "body", "shape": "cylinder", "radius": 40, "depth": 95, "location": [0, 0, 47.5], "bevel": 2, "color": "#1f3a8a", "group": "mug", "cut": [{"shape": "cylinder", "radius": 36, "depth": 95, "location": [0, 0, 51.5]}]}, {"name": "handle", "shape": "torus", "major": 22, "minor": 5, "location": [44, 0, 50], "rotation": [90, 0, 0], "color": "#1f3a8a", "group": "mug", "cut": [{"shape": "box", "size": [80, 20, 80], "location": [0, 0, 50]}]}]}
